description: Create or update a Linear project. If `id` is provided, updates the existing project; otherwise creates a new one. When creating, `name` and at least one team (via `addTeams` or `setTeams`) are required. Pass `template` to create the project from a project template. To change parts of the description without resending all of it, pass `patch` instead of `description`. `state` resolves against the project statuses of the lead team, so pass `leadTeam` when creating a multi-team project whose teams use different statuses.

addInitiatives.description: Initiatives to add. Initiative name, ID, identifier (e.g., I-123), or slug

addTeams.description: Team name or ID to add

description.description: Content as Markdown. Do not escape the string — use literal newlines and special characters, not escape sequences. To mention a user, use @displayName (e.g., @johndoe)

icon.description: Icon name or emoji code (e.g. "Rocket" or ":eagle:"), not a raw Unicode emoji

id.description: Project name, ID, identifier (e.g., P-ENG-123), or slug. If provided, updates the existing project

labels.description: Label names or IDs as a JSON array of strings (e.g. ["Bug", "Urgent"]). Replaces the full label set; existing labels not included are removed. Omit to leave labels unchanged

lead.description: User ID, name, email, or "me". Null to remove, except on create with a template that names a lead

leadTeam.description: Team that leads the project. Team name or ID. Overrides the default lead team; added to the project's teams when not among them

links.description: External resource links to add [{url, title}]. Append-only; existing links are never removed

patch.description: Partial edits applied to the current content, in order and atomically (one failing operation aborts the whole save). Every anchor string must match the current content exactly once. Only valid on update, in place of the full content/description field

new_string.description: Replacement text. Empty string deletes the match

old_string.description: Exact text to replace. Must match the current content exactly once

replace_all.description: Replace every occurrence instead of requiring a unique match

anchor.description: Exact text to insert before. Must match the current content exactly once

text.description: Text to insert directly before the anchor. Include separators (e.g. "\n\n")

anchor.description: Exact text to insert after. Must match the current content exactly once

text.description: Text to insert directly after the anchor. Include separators (e.g. "\n\n")
Text to insert at the very start of the content
Text to insert at the very end of the content

from.description: Exact text where the range starts (inclusive). Must match exactly once

new_string.description: Text replacing the range. Empty string deletes it

to.description: Exact text where the range ends (exclusive, stays in place). Must match exactly once after `from`

removeInitiatives.description: Initiatives to remove. Initiative name, ID, identifier (e.g., I-123), or slug

removeTeams.description: Team name or ID to remove

setInitiatives.description: Replace all initiatives with these. Initiative name, ID, identifier (e.g., I-123), or slug. Cannot combine with addInitiatives/removeInitiatives

setTeams.description: Replace all teams with these. Cannot combine with addTeams/removeTeams

startDate.description: Start date (ISO format). Pair with startDateResolution to indicate precision (e.g. month, quarter). Null to remove

startDateResolution.description: Start date resolution. Null for an exact day. When omitted, the current resolution stays and the date snaps to it

state.description: Project status name, type, or ID. Names resolve within the lead team's project statuses. If the lead team is unknown, standard labels resolve as status types; custom names require a status ID or leadTeam

targetDate.description: Target date (ISO format). Pair with targetDateResolution to indicate precision (e.g. month, quarter). Null to remove

targetDateResolution.description: Target date resolution. Null for an exact day. When omitted, the current resolution stays and the date snaps to it

template.description: Template name or ID. Applied on create only. The template fills in the content, fields, and sub-issues server-side. A `description` replaces the template body rather than merging with it, but an empty `description` keeps the template body. Labels merge with the template's own

name: save_project
title: Save project
